title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
description: Learn the core concepts of machine learning including supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, and model evaluation. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to ML with hands-on projects.

lessons.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
lessons.content:
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn and improve from experience without being explicitly programmed. In this lesson, we explore the fundamental concepts that form the foundation of modern ML.

## Key Concepts

- **Supervised Learning**: Learning with labeled data
- **Unsupervised Learning**: Finding patterns in unlabeled data
- **Reinforcement Learning**: Learning through trial and error

## Types of Machine Learning

1. Supervised Learning
   - Regression: Predicting continuous values
   - Classification: Predicting categories

2. Unsupervised Learning
   - Clustering: Grouping similar data points
   - Dimensionality Reduction: Reducing feature space

3. Reinforcement Learning
   - Agent-based learning
   - Reward-based systems
keyPoints: ML enables computers to learn from data
Three main types: supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement
Features and labels are fundamental concepts
lessons.summary: Machine learning is a transformative technology that allows computers to learn from data without explicit programming. This lesson covered the three main types: supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.

lessons.title: Data Preprocessing & Feature Engineering
lessons.content:
Data preprocessing is a crucial step in the machine learning pipeline. Raw data is often messy and needs to be cleaned and transformed before it can be used effectively.

## Data Cleaning Steps

1. Handling missing values
2. Removing duplicates
3. Outlier detection and treatment

## Feature Engineering Techniques

- Feature scaling (Standardization, Normalization)
- Feature encoding (One-hot, Label encoding)
- Feature selection methods
keyPoints: Data quality directly impacts model performance
Feature engineering can significantly improve results
lessons.summary: This lesson covered the importance of data preprocessing and feature engineering in building effective machine learning models.

lessons.title: Linear Regression & Gradient Descent
lessons.content:
Linear regression is one of the simplest and most widely used algorithms in machine learning. It models the relationship between input features and a continuous output variable.

## Understanding Linear Regression

$y = mx + b$

Where:
- $y$ is the predicted value
- $x$ is the input feature
- $m$ is the slope
- $b$ is the intercept

## Gradient Descent Optimization

Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize the cost function by iteratively updating model parameters.
keyPoints: Gradient descent minimizes the cost function
lessons.summary: This lesson explained linear regression fundamentals and the gradient descent optimization algorithm used to train models.

lessons.title: Neural Networks & Deep Learning
lessons.content:
Neural networks are computing systems inspired by biological neural networks. They form the foundation of deep learning, which has revolutionized AI in recent years.

## Architecture

- Input Layer
- Hidden Layers
- Output Layer

## Activation Functions

- ReLU (Rectified Linear Unit)
- Sigmoid
- Tanh
- Softmax
keyPoints: Deep learning uses multiple hidden layers
lessons.summary: Introduction to neural network architecture and activation functions that power deep learning models.

lessons.title: Model Evaluation & Validation
lessons.content:
Evaluating model performance is critical to building reliable ML systems. This lesson covers various metrics and validation techniques.

## Evaluation Metrics

- Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score
- Confusion Matrix
- ROC Curve & AUC

## Validation Techniques

- Train/Test Split
- Cross-Validation
- Bootstrap
keyPoints: Choose metrics based on problem type
lessons.summary: Comprehensive overview of model evaluation metrics and validation techniques for reliable ML assessment.
